purpose: Grid-level historical-support audit for finalized Step-29D NDWI scenarios

grid_level_checks: scenario increment <= grid historical q90 positive annual change
scenario increment <= grid historical max positive annual change
scenario NDWI within grid historical NDWI range
scenario newly exits grid historical range

support_classes.strong_within_grid_support: increment within grid q90 positive-change support AND scenario NDWI within grid historical range
support_classes.within_grid_max_support: increment exceeds grid q90 but remains within grid max positive-change support AND scenario NDWI within historical range
support_classes.extrapolative_for_selected_grid: increment exceeds grid max positive annual change, grid has no positive historical change, or scenario NDWI lies outside that grid's historical NDWI range

interpretation: Extrapolative scenarios are not deleted. They should be shown with lower-confidence / extrapolation wording for that selected grid.
